name: Fallen Angels 墮落天使 (1995)
who_line: William Chang’s 90s Hong Kong cool: East and West worn whenever you want.
who: Fallen Angels is the sister film to Chungking Express (see the Faye Wong file). William Chang did the costumes and sets and was nominated at the Hong Kong Film Awards for Best Costume and Make-up Design. Karen Mok won Best Supporting Actress.

quotes.text: You can use the Western side of you, or you can use Eastern side, whenever you want. It’s fluid.
That dress is all about restraint.
quotes.said_to: William Chang on the qipao, WestEast

moments.title: Karen Mok as “Blondie” (added 19 Oct 2026 digest)

moments.designer_season: Costumes: William Chang (film credit). No fashion season.
moments.where_it_lives: Film stills (Cahiers de Mode). Reference only, not on this disk.
moments.why_iconic: Cahiers de Mode credits the look with influencing Shibuya kogal style.
